Game Overview

At its heart, Slime Jump is a platformer game about bounce, stick, and strategize in Slime Jump. Master your jumping prowess as a blue slime, navigating perilous platforms and dodging crafty enemies. Balance energy wisely while sticking to walls and avoid instant death from spikes. Touch the ground to recharge and perfect your precision jumps to survive.
